notes: Entire SMIP event fleet is gasoline. No electric-pack cases.

cases.title: Dead after the trailer

cart.notes: Older Club Car utility. Just came off an enclosed Trailer Transit load.

cases.ticket: Unloaded this morning off the enclosed trailer. Key is on. Pedal goes down and the engine never turns over. Fuel gauge is sitting on empty.
cases.cause: It sat through the haul with almost no gas, and the kill / run switch was left off after unload. Fill it, kill switch on, then it fires. Not an engine.

checks.label: Chock it or confirm it can't roll
Check the kill / run / neutral lockout switch
Check the gas
Confirm key on and pedal / FNR in a start position
Put gas in it, kill switch on, restart and test drive

forbidden.label: Calling for an engine or carb first
Treating it like an electric pack cart

cases.title: Cranks, never fires

cart.notes: Common 4-passenger Club Car. Same family as the ones with oil-leak writeups.

cases.setting: Charlotte shop. Came back from last weekend.
cases.ticket: Engine cranks but never starts. You can smell raw gas around the carb. Operator has been trying to start it over and over.
cases.cause: Fouled spark plug. They flooded it. Pull the plug, read it, put a new one in, don't keep cranking.

checks.label: Key off and pull the plug wire before you work the plug
Confirm it has gas and is actually cranking
Check for spark
Pull and read the spark plug
Replace the plug and restart without flooding it again

forbidden.label: Calling the engine dead because it won't pop

cases.title: Starts, then dies on the way out

cart.engine: Gas / EFI or carb as equipped
cart.notes: Flip-seat 4PF. Sat a couple weeks after the last event.

cases.setting: SMIP shop, Monday. They need it for a local pull.
cases.ticket: Starts on the first try, runs about ten seconds, then dies. Restarts every time. Same cycle if you keep doing it.
cases.cause: Stale ethanol gas and a clogged fuel filter. Bowl/injector is starving once the prime is gone. Fresh fuel and a filter, then it holds.

checks.label: Watch it start and die instead of guessing
Ask how old the gas is / smell it / check the tank
Check the fuel filter / fuel getting to the carb or injector
Check the fuel cap vent if it dies after a short run
Fresh gas and a new filter, then a longer test drive

forbidden.label: Replacing the carb with no fuel-side check

cases.title: Oil all over the side

cart.notes: Real fleet writeup: oil leak side gasket. Same leak showed up on EZ-GO units at Darlington.

cases.setting: After TSS. Double Bogey hauled it. Sitting in the out-of-service row.
cases.ticket: Oil on the left side of the engine and a drip under the cart on the trailer. They drove it in anyway.
cases.cause: Side case gasket. Check oil first so they didn't already kill it, then gasket — not a new engine unless it's empty and knocking.

checks.label: Check the oil level before you run it again
Find where it's coming from (side gasket vs drain vs valve cover)
Do not send it back out low on oil
Replace the side gasket, refill oil, write the date on the tank

forbidden.label: Sending it to the next event leaking
aliases: just add oil and send it

cases.title: It sounds like rocks in a can

cart.notes: Real note from Kansas drop-off: internal engine noise.

cases.setting: Kansas. They dropped it at the track and called it in.
cases.ticket: Cart runs, but there's a knock from inside the engine. It got louder crossing the lot.
cases.cause: Internal engine noise. Check oil, shut it down, don't keep driving it. This is a park-it and tear-down, not a carb clean.

checks.label: Check oil immediately
Shut it off. Don't keep driving a knocking motor
Figure out if it's engine, clutch, or exhaust heat shield
Tag it out of service and write the work order

forbidden.label: Cleaning the carb on a knock
Leaving it in the rental row

cases.title: Valor dies after it gets hot

cart.notes: NP / TV compound. EX1 hates heat, dust, and idle. Drive-on only — never reverse a Valor onto a trailer.

cases.setting: Iowa infield. Been running suite shuttles in the sun.
cases.ticket: Runs about 20 minutes, then loses power and dies. Restarts after it sits. Driver-side rear of the engine is packed with dirt.
cases.cause: Clogged CVT / cooling filter and dirty cooling fins. Heat soak. Clean the fins and the driver's-side screen. Not a new engine.

checks.label: Note that it only dies hot, then comes back
Check the driver's-side CVT / cooling filter
Blow out the cooling fins
Check oil level and the air filter
Clean the cooling path and test it hot again
Valor gets driven on a trailer, never reversed on

forbidden.label: Replacing the EX1 because it heat-soaked

cases.title: Valor won't crank

cart.notes: EX1 uses an ISG, not a regular starter. Early ISG controllers die from heat and vibration.

cases.setting: Compound, late afternoon. Cart is heat-soaked.
cases.ticket: Key on, lights work, engine will not crank. They jumped it off another cart and it still will not crank.
cases.cause: ISG controller. 12V battery and connections were fine. Updated controller (10017118) is the fleet part, not a starter motor.

checks.label: Meter the 12V battery and clean the cables first
This cart has an ISG, not a regular starter
Note key-on behavior (lights vs crank)
Replace the ISG controller (updated heat-sink unit) and retest

cases.title: Engine screams, cart crawls

cart.notes: Heavy 6-pass. These cook belts on the suite hill.

cases.ticket: Fine around the compound. Halfway up the suite hill the engine revs and the cart barely moves. You can smell belt.
cases.cause: Glazed / worn drive belt (or clutch). Engine is fine. Replace the belt, inspect drive/driven clutch, test the hill again.

checks.label: Reproduce under load, not just in the bay
Inspect the drive belt
Check drive and driven clutch
Replace the belt and retest the hill

forbidden.label: Blaming the motor because it revs

cases.title: Pulls left after offload

cart.notes: Came off a Sun Valley at Richmond. Strap marks on the cowl.

cases.setting: Just offloaded. They drove it 40 feet and parked it.
cases.ticket: Pulls hard left as soon as you start rolling. Engine sounds fine. They only drove it off the trailer about 40 feet.
cases.cause: Bent tie rod / steering from the strap or a hit during unload. Mechanical. Don't touch the motor.

checks.label: Drive it and confirm the pull
Inspect tie rods, steering, A-arms, and rims
Don't treat a pull as an engine problem
Replace/straighten the bent part and test again
Write it up as transit/unload damage

forbidden.label: Tearing into the engine for a steering pull

cases.title: It shut off and the light's on

cart.notes: Shop utility. They've been tugging with it all week.

cases.ticket: Died in the alley. Low oil / fuel light is on. Operator wants it jumped so they can keep using it.
cases.cause: Low oil, not a dead battery. These engines shut down on purpose. Check oil, find the leak, fill it. Date the tank when you're done.

checks.label: Read the low oil / fuel light instead of ignoring it
Check the oil before you restart it
Check fuel if the light is shared
Find why the oil is gone
Fill with the right oil, fix the leak, write the date on the tank

forbidden.label: Jumping it and sending it back out
